title: Improving the game UI to help the User know what to do + adding immersion to the world
author: fapfap_ahh
selftext:
[https://imgur.com/a/lBPVO0i](https://imgur.com/a/lBPVO0i)

As I playtest, I realize that I know how to play my game and it's mechanics, but a new user may struggle without either: tutorial, help menu, tooltips, etc.

  
Past few days I've been working on making the UIs more intuitive, adding full map with clickable items, and also improving the outside forest to keep feeling like a real "forest."

Full list of additions in these past few sessions:

\* Full map (M): a plan of the station showing where everything is, and the forest map with a legend.

\* If you're missing a tool, its icon shows right on the option. Hover over it and it pops out with the tool's name, so you know what to go find.

\* Talking to people the conversations now type out like a teleprinter readout

\* Crows hop, peck and fly over in flocks

\* Owls hoot and watch you, shift trees, and fly off when you get close.

\* Deer, boar, wolves and bears roam (next up: predators actually hunting prey).

\* More Forest items: different spruce styles, dead snags, dry reeds by the water.

\* Few more music soundtracks for day and night.
